subject: EdgeCast discovery: integration ops + signals recap
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@edgecast.com>, Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@edgecast.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 6 Dec 2025 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: EdgeCast discovery: integration ops + signals recap

Alex / Samira — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap to confirm the signals we heard and the next actions we discussed, so we’re all aligned before we draft a PoC plan.

Pain points you called out:
- Unreliable retrieval latency from your legacy reranker, causing slow search UX on peak traffic.
- Need to support structured, multi-field search responses in JSON for downstream systems (not just free-text).
- Tight budget on inference spend; want clear cost/latency tradeoffs and predictable throughput for peak 8–10pm PST traffic.

Goals (what success looks like):
1) Replace current semantic reranker for internal docs and user search to drop median query latency by ~40% and improve top-5 relevancy.
2) Expose a streaming response for the UI to show progressive results while reranking completes.
3) Deliver a JSON-structured output with top_k, scores, and normalized metadata for the UI to ingest directly.

Integration & product fit notes we discussed:
- SDK changes: you want a thin wrapper in your Node service to call Redwood's streaming endpoint and a separate embedding endpoint for periodic indexing. We suggested using our JS SDK v2 with built-in streaming helpers.
- Function calling: you asked about enforcing structured outputs — we recommended function-calling to validate schema on model output and return machine-readable JSON.
- Streaming: we can provide chunked token streaming to the browser via your websocket layer; this reduces perceived latency for users.
- Embeddings + reranking: suggested two-step flow — candidate retrieval by vector similarity (your current vector DB) followed by a lightweight reranker to rescore top 50 results using a smaller Llama-variant we can host in Dedicated capacity.

Operational asks you raised:
- SOC2 evidence and data retention policies (Samira to share specifics).
- SSO + SCIM for service accounts.
- A lightweight cost projection for 100k queries/day and a peak SLA during your nightly batch window.

Next steps we agreed on:
- EdgeCast to share the security questionnaire + sample dataset for a mock index by Tue 12/9 (Samira).
- Redwood to send a 2-week PoC plan and cost ballpark by EOD Mon 12/8 (Diego / Vivek).
- Proposal: 2-week PoC: ingest 50k docs, index embeddings, run A/B with current reranker on top-5 metrics, and demo results.

Attachments: I’m attaching a brief requirements spreadsheet template (edgecast_poc_requirements.xlsx) and an initial SDK-change sketch (redwood_sdk-change-proposal.pdf) — please fill the spreadsheet and flag any missing fields.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the questionnaire & sample dataset and will draft the PoC plan for Monday.

—
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0189
From: Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@edgecast.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Porter <alex.porter@edgecast.com>, EdgeCast IT <it@edgecast.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 6 Dec 2025 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EdgeCast discovery: integration ops + signals recap

Diego — thanks for the thorough recap, this matches our notes. Couple clarifications and additions from the engineering/security side: 

Clarifications:
- Topology: our retrieval layer currently returns top 200 candidates from our vector DB (FAISS) and we run a CPU-based reranker. The team prefers reranker latency be sub-100ms p95 for the top-50 block to avoid front-end blocking.
- Streaming: the UI team wants the first rough result within <150ms (perceived), then full top-5 within 800ms. We understand final numbers may vary — we just want a sketch of how Redwood will meet these targets during PoC.

Security/ops requests:
- We will send our security questionnaire by EOD Mon 12/8. The questions include KMS details, data partitioning, audit log retention, and whether ephemeral KV caching keeps any PII.
- Can Redwood support bringing your Private deployment into our AWS account (VPC peering) for the PoC, or will the PoC run on Dedicated cloud-hosted nodes behind your tenancy? We prefer the former if possible.

Deliverables we’ll provide:
- Sample dataset (anonymized) + expected schema.
- Access to a staging vector index and a replay of 24h query logs to help size traffic.

I’ll attach the questionnaire once internal legal signs off; target Mon 12/8.

Best,
Samira
Sr. Engineering Manager — Search
EdgeCast Systems
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Porter <alex.porter@edgecast.com>, Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@edgecast.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: EdgeCast discovery: integration ops + signals recap

Vivek / Steph — fwd’ing the thread. EdgeCast is a good-fit opportunity for a short PoC (candidate retrieval + reranker swap) but they have strict latency targets and a security questionnaire incoming. Can you help by: 

1) Vivek — draft the 2-week technical PoC plan + resource ask (Dedicated/minimum GPU sizes, expected tokens/day, and an initial cost projection for 100k q/day). Include an approach for streaming tokens to their UI (websocket pattern) and how we’ll implement function-calling for structured output validation. Attach the SDK-change sketch and highlight any breaking changes for their Node service.

2) Steph — take point on the commercial side: a ballpark number for the PoC (credit/discount?), and coordinate quick legal review of their security questionnaire once they send. Also please prepare a short MOU template we can use to outline access, data handling, and timelines.

They’re aiming to deliver the questionnaire and sample dataset by EOD Mon (12/8) — I’ll circulate your drafts as soon as they land.

Thanks
—
Diego
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Porter <alex.porter@edgecast.com>, Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@edgecast.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Dec 2025 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EdgeCast discovery: integration ops + signals recap — PoC plan + tech notes

Diego / Steph / Alex / Samira — attaching a concise PoC plan below and the SDK-change sketch (redwood_sdk-change-proposal.pdf). I also uploaded a sizing worksheet to the Drive link in the thread.

PoC summary (2 weeks):
Week 1 — Ingest & baseline
- Day 1–2: Receive sample dataset + schema + 24h query logs. Spin up a sandbox vector index and ingest 50k docs.
- Day 3–5: Generate embeddings (batch job) using our embeddings endpoint; measure throughput & cost. Run baseline retrieval + current reranker to capture top-5 metrics.

Week 2 — Reranker swap + streaming
- Day 6–9: Provision Dedicated node (we recommend 1xA10x8) and deploy the smaller Llama-variant reranker quantized to int8 for cost reasons. Implement an HTTP -> websocket streaming adapter for your UI; Redwood SDK’s streaming helper will be used on the service layer.
- Day 10–12: Run A/B tests (traffic split 50/50) against current reranker. Capture p50/p95 latency and top-5 relevancy metrics.
- Day 13–14: Review results, tune thresholding, prepare demo and handoff notes.

How we’ll meet your latency goals:
- Candidate window limited to top-50 for reranker to keep p95 < 100ms.
- Use incremental streaming: first token block sent to UI after model returns top-1 candidate score (perceived <150ms), then full top-5 once reranker finishes.

Structured outputs & function calling:
- We'll define a strict JSON schema (fields: id, score, title, snippet, metadata{source, date}) and use function-calling to force model outputs into that schema. Any deviation will be rejected and logged. That output is directly stored in your downstream service.

Security & deployment options:
- For PoC we can offer two options:
  A) Dedicated hosted by Redwood with VPC peering and private networking connections (simpler, faster).
  B) Private deployment into EdgeCast AWS account (requires legal + network setup; adds ~3 business days).
- We will provide SOC2 artifacts and configured audit logs for the PoC environment.

Costs & ask:
- Ballpark for 2-week PoC (including Dedicated infra + engineering time): $12k–$18k (we can credit part if they move to a paid Dedicated contract). Detailed line items attached in the pricing tab of the worksheet.

Deliverables we’ll send Monday EOD:
- Detailed PoC plan PDF + timeline.
- SDK change notes and a small code snippet for Node integration (non-breaking adapter).
- Cost projection worksheet (in Drive).

If that looks good, Diego — please confirm and we’ll schedule a kickoff on Wed 12/10 (30–45 mins) once the questionnaire and sample dataset land.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_sdk-change-proposal.pdf, edgecast_poc_requirements.xlsx
